risk: Dense atmosphere escapes faster than replacement capacity
mitigation: Upper-atmosphere kinetic model; thermospheric cooling; volatile reserve; abort before global release.

risk: Nitrogen supply cannot be acquired ethically or economically
mitigation: Outer-system resource census; multiple buffer-gas architectures; hybrid paraterraforming fallback.

risk: Long lunar night causes widespread freeze-out and ecosystem crash
mitigation: Ocean/soil heat storage, greenhouse tuning, circulation control, refugia, orbital energy support.

risk: Day-side cloud or greenhouse feedback drives dangerous warming
mitigation: 3-D GCM ensembles, active albedo management, trace-gas removal.

risk: 0.16 g is inadequate for lifelong human health or reproduction
mitigation: Rotating habitats and health centers; multi-generation animal studies; settlement design assumes artificial gravity.

risk: Wildfire becomes uncontrollable in oxygenated low gravity
mitigation: Oxygen fraction limits, firebreak landscapes, low-g combustion research, rapid atmospheric isolation zones.

risk: Raw regolith remains toxic or infertile at scale
mitigation: Wash, grind, weather, inoculate and amend; do not expose settlements to untreated fines.

risk: Imported volatile capture causes impacts or orbital debris
mitigation: Process resources away from Moon; deliver in small packets; redundant capture corridors.

risk: Atmosphere eliminates unique vacuum astronomy and contaminates ancient records
mitigation: Archive before transformation; retain orbital/farside radio observatories; international consent.

risk: Global biosphere enters unstable boom-bust oxygen/carbon cycles
mitigation: Large reservoirs, slow release, automated carbon/oxygen controls, preserved seed and microbe banks.

risk: Atmospheric drag destroys low lunar satellites and launch architecture
mitigation: Transition orbital assets before pressure rise; establish high-orbit and tether network.

risk: Governance conflict makes irreversible intervention illegitimate
mitigation: Multilateral authorization, transparent modeling, rights regime, compensation and veto thresholds.

risk: Atmospheric superrotation or terminator fronts exceed infrastructure design loads
mitigation: GCM and staged-pressure tests; conservative wind load codes; sheltered settlement siting.

risk: Ocean placement destabilizes crustal mass distribution or inundates heritage zones
mitigation: Basin-by-basin geodesy, staged filling, preserve protected regions.

risk: Biological contamination reaches protected scientific reserves before authorization
mitigation: Sterile buffer zones, sealed pilots, monitoring, legal liability.
